name: Hazuki
source:
Hazuki is the human appearance of the Celaeno Fragments. She addresses her writer/creator, [url=/c12705]Laban Shrewsbury[/url], as "daddy". She can summon the Deus Machina Ambrose, a more powerful version of the Lord Byakhee. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Demonbane_characters#Characters_that_appear_in_other_media]Wikipedia[/url].]

"Yes, Daddy."

[From the [url=http://www.demonbane.com/special/]Demonbane Official Site[/url]]
